(async function () {
  const { createCommandsController } = await import("/features/commands/controller.js");
  const { createCompletion } = await import("/features/sessions/completion.js");
  const { createSessionsController } = await import("/features/sessions/controller.js");
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const checks = [], requests = [];
  const check = (condition, label) => { if (!condition) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
  const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
  const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 8000; while (!predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out: " + predicate); await tick(); } };
  const project = "C:/fixture";
  const sessions = [
    { id: "a", title: "프런트", agent: "claude", state: "running", projectPath: project, createdAt: "2026-01-01" },
    { id: "b", title: "서버", agent: "codex", state: "idle", projectPath: project, createdAt: "2026-01-02" },
    { id: "x", title: "다른 프로젝트", agent: "claude", state: "idle", projectPath: "C:/other", createdAt: "2026-01-03" },
    { id: "chat", title: "채팅", agent: "claude", state: "idle", chat: true, projectPath: null, createdAt: "2026-01-04" },
  ];
  const group = { id: "cmd-group", kind: "group", title: "병렬 구현", members: ["a", "b"], state: "idle", projectPath: project };
  const data = { commands: [group], shells: [], sessions };
  const navigation = { project, view: "project" };
  const api = async (method, url, body) => {
    requests.push({ method, url, body });
    if (method === "GET" && url.startsWith("/api/commands?")) return { shells: [], commands: data.commands };
    if (method === "POST" && url.endsWith("/run")) return {};
    if (method === "POST" && url === "/api/commands") { const node = { ...body, id: "cmd-new", state: "idle" }; data.commands.push(node); return node; }
    if (method === "GET" && url.startsWith("/api/skills?")) return [{ name: "code-review", description: "변경을 리뷰한다", scope: "claude" }, { name: "issue-fix", description: "이슈를 고친다", scope: "project" }];
    if (method === "GET" && url.startsWith("/api/tasks?")) return { tasks: [{ id: "task-ui", title: "시각 개선", branch: "feature/preview" }] };
    if (method === "POST" && url === "/api/sessions/s1/messages") return { queued: false };
    if (method === "GET" && url.startsWith("/api/sessions/s1/files?q=")) {
      const q = decodeURIComponent(url.split("q=")[1]);
      return { files: ["src/", "src/app.js", "src/lib/", "README.md", "docs/my notes.md"].filter((f) => f.includes(q)) };
    }
    throw Error("Unexpected API " + method + " " + url);
  };
  let controller;
  const renderGraph = () => $("p-graph").replaceChildren(...data.commands.map((node) => controller.commandNode(node)));
  controller = createCommandsController({ api, loadLinks: async () => {}, renderGraph, connectCreatedGraphNode: async () => {}, commandById: (id) => data.commands.find((n) => n.id === id), data, navigation });
  $("view-dashboard").hidden = true; $("view-project").hidden = false; renderGraph();

  // ── 세션 묶음 노드 ──
  let card = $("p-graph").querySelector('[data-id="cmd-group"]');
  check(card.classList.contains("gcmd-group") && card.querySelectorAll(".group-chip").length === 2, "group card lists its member sessions");
  check(card.textContent.includes("진행 중 1/2") && card.querySelector(".gcmd-btn").disabled, "group waits while a member is running");
  check(card.querySelector(".group-chip.busy")?.textContent === "프런트", "running member is highlighted");
  sessions[0].state = "idle"; renderGraph();
  card = $("p-graph").querySelector('[data-id="cmd-group"]');
  check(!card.querySelector(".gcmd-btn").disabled && card.textContent.includes("모두 끝남"), "group can hand off once every member is idle");
  await controller.runCommand(group);
  check(requests.some((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.url === "/api/commands/cmd-group/run"), "manual hand-off calls run");
  sessions[1].state = "paused"; renderGraph();
  const before = requests.length;
  document.querySelectorAll(".error-toast").forEach((toast) => toast.remove());
  await controller.runCommand(group);
  const alerted = document.querySelector(".error-toast")?.textContent ?? "";
  check(requests.length === before && alerted.includes("진행 중"), "paused member blocks manual hand-off");
  document.querySelectorAll(".error-toast").forEach((toast) => toast.remove());
  sessions[1].state = "idle";

  controller.openCommandDialog(null, { x: 10, y: 20 }, null, "group", { members: ["b"] });
  const boxes = [...$("group-members").querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]")];
  check(!$("group-members-row").hidden && $("command-settings").hidden && $("command-text-row").hidden && $("button-prompt-row").hidden, "group editor shows only member picker");
  check(boxes.map((b) => b.value).join() === "a,b", "only this project's non-chat sessions can be grouped");
  check(!boxes[0].checked && boxes[1].checked, "selected graph sessions are preselected");
  boxes[0].checked = true; $("command-title").value = "묶음 2";
  $("command-form").querySelector('[value="ok"]').click();
  await until(() => !$("command-dialog").open);
  const created = requests.find((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.url === "/api/commands");
  check(created.body.kind === "group" && created.body.members.join() === "a,b" && !Object.hasOwn(created.body, "cwdMode"), "group creation saves members");

  // ── 작성창 자동 완성 ──
  $("view-project").hidden = true; $("view-session").hidden = false;
  const textarea = $("s-prompt");
  let builtin = null, submitted = 0, escaped = 0;
  let provideReferences = () => [];
  const completion = createCompletion({ textarea, api, getSession: () => ({ id: "s1", projectPath: project }), onBuiltin: (name) => { builtin = name; }, getReferences: () => provideReferences() });
  // 작성창의 보내기(Enter) 처리는 자동 완성 뒤에 등록된다.
  textarea.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") submitted++; });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape" && !e.defaultPrevented) escaped++; });
  const menu = $("s-prompt-complete");
  const type = (value) => { textarea.focus(); textarea.value = value; textarea.setSelectionRange(value.length, value.length); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event("input")); };
  const key = (k) => textarea.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: k, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));

  type("/");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.children.length >= 5);
  check(menu.textContent.includes("/clear") && menu.textContent.includes("/code-review") && menu.textContent.includes("Claude 스킬"), "slash lists built-in commands and skills");
  type("/co");
  await until(() => menu.children.length === 1);
  key("Enter");
  check(textarea.value === "/code-review " && submitted === 0 && menu.hidden, "Enter inserts the skill without sending");
  type("검토 @src/a");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.textContent.includes("src/app.js"));
  const fileRow = [...menu.children].find((node) => node.querySelector(".complete-path")?.textContent === "src/app.js");
  check(fileRow?.querySelector(".complete-file")?.textContent === "app.js"
    && fileRow.querySelector(".complete-file").compareDocumentPosition(fileRow.querySelector(".complete-path")) === Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING
    && getComputedStyle(fileRow.querySelector(".complete-file")).textOverflow !== "ellipsis", "file rows show the whole name first and the full path after it");
  key("Enter");
  check(textarea.value === "검토 @app.js " && submitted === 0, "Enter inserts the file reference by its name");
  const chip = textarea.parentElement.querySelector(".ref-mirror .ref-chip");
  check(textarea.parentElement.classList.contains("has-refs") && chip?.textContent === "@app.js", "the chosen file is drawn as a highlighted reference");
  check(completion.expand(textarea.value.trim()) === "검토 @src/app.js", "sending restores the full file path");
  check(JSON.stringify(completion.references("검토 @app.js @app.js")) === JSON.stringify([{ label: "app.js", path: "src/app.js" }]), "stored references retain the label and original path once");
  check(completion.references("고르지 않은 @README.md 와 지운 참조").length === 0, "only selected references actually present in the prompt are stored");
  type("검토 @app.js 다음 말");
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
  check(menu.hidden, "text typed after a chosen reference is not searched");
  type("@my no");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.textContent.includes("docs/my notes.md"));
  key("Enter");
  check(textarea.value === "@my notes.md ", "a query with a space keeps searching and inserts the file name without quotes");
  check(completion.expand(textarea.value.trim()) === '@"docs/my notes.md"', "a spaced file name is quoted only when sending");
  // 조사를 붙여도 참조로 남고, 보낼 때는 따옴표로 감싼 전체 경로가 된다.
  type("@my notes.md에 적기");
  await tick();
  check(textarea.parentElement.querySelector(".ref-mirror .ref-chip")?.textContent === "@my notes.md", "a particle glued after a reference keeps the highlight");
  check(completion.expand(textarea.value) === '@"docs/my notes.md"에 적기', "a glued reference is sent as a quoted full path");
  // 커서 뒤에 이미 쓴 글은 파일을 골라도 지워지지 않는다.
  textarea.value = "@src/a 다음 글자"; textarea.setSelectionRange(6, 6); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.textContent.includes("src/app.js"));
  key("Enter");
  check(textarea.value === "@app.js 다음 글자", "choosing a file keeps the text after the caret");
  // 참조를 복사해 붙여넣으면 파란 참조가 그대로 남는다. 다른 앱에는 보통 공백으로 간다.
  const clip = () => { const store = new Map(); return { store, setData: (t, v) => store.set(t, v), getData: (t) => store.get(t) ?? "" }; };
  type("@my notes.md에 적기");
  textarea.setSelectionRange(0, textarea.value.length);
  const copied = clip();
  const copyEvent = new Event("cut", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); copyEvent.clipboardData = copied;
  textarea.dispatchEvent(copyEvent);
  check(textarea.value === "" && copied.store.get("text/plain") === "@my notes.md에 적기", "cutting a reference leaves plain spaces for other apps");
  const pasteEvent = new Event("paste", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); pasteEvent.clipboardData = copied;
  textarea.dispatchEvent(pasteEvent);
  await tick();
  check(textarea.value === "@my notes.md에 적기" && textarea.parentElement.querySelector(".ref-mirror .ref-chip")?.textContent === "@my notes.md"
    && completion.expand(textarea.value) === '@"docs/my notes.md"에 적기', "pasting a copied reference restores the highlighted reference");
  // 참조 바로 뒤의 Backspace는 참조를 통째로 지운다.
  textarea.setSelectionRange(12, 12);
  key("Backspace");
  check(textarea.value === "에 적기", "Backspace right after a reference removes the whole reference");
  type("@없는 파일");
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
  type("@없는 파일 이름도");
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
  check(menu.hidden, "a spaced query with no results stops searching");
  type("@sr");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.children.length >= 2);
  key("ArrowDown"); key("Tab");
  check(textarea.value === "@app.js ", "arrow keys move the selection");
  type("@src");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden);
  key("Escape");
  check(menu.hidden && escaped === 0, "Escape closes the list without pausing the session");
  type("/cl");
  await until(() => !menu.hidden && menu.textContent.includes("/clear"));
  key("Enter");
  check(builtin === "clear" && textarea.value === "", "choosing a built-in command runs it");
  type("평범한 요청");
  await tick();
  key("Enter");
  check(menu.hidden && submitted === 1, "Enter sends when no list is open");
  let releaseReferences;
  provideReferences = () => new Promise((resolve) => { releaseReferences = resolve; });
  type("@delayed");
  await until(() => releaseReferences);
  completion.close();
  releaseReferences([{ type: "session", value: "delayed session", path: "agenthub://session/b" }]);
  await tick();
  check(menu.hidden, "closing completion cancels late file and reference results");

  // Exercise the real session send handler with fresh composer elements, so the
  // standalone completion listeners above cannot interfere with submission.
  completion.close();
  const oldForm = $("s-form");
  oldForm.querySelector(".complete-menu")?.remove();
  textarea.value = "";
  textarea.parentElement.replaceWith(textarea);
  oldForm.replaceWith(oldForm.cloneNode(true));
  const sessionData = { sessions: [...sessions, { id: "duplicate", title: "서버", state: "idle", projectPath: project }], links: [], current: {
    id: "s1", title: "참조 작성", projectPath: project, cwd: project, projectName: "Fixture", agent: "codex", state: "idle", events: [], queue: [], permission: "workspace-write",
  } };
  navigation.view = "session";
  const sessionController = createSessionsController({ api, data: sessionData, navigation,
    sessionById: (id) => sessionData.sessions.find((item) => item.id === id), eventsList: () => $("s-events"),
  });
  sessionController.renderSession();
  const prompt = $("s-prompt"), realMenu = $("s-prompt-complete");
  const input = (value) => { prompt.focus(); prompt.value = value; prompt.setSelectionRange(value.length, value.length); prompt.dispatchEvent(new Event("input")); };
  const press = (value) => prompt.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: value, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  input("@세션/서버");
  await until(() => !realMenu.hidden && realMenu.textContent.includes("서버"));
  press("Enter");
  check(prompt.value === "@세션/서버 ", "session completion inserts a readable reference without sending");
  input(prompt.value + "@세션/서버");
  await until(() => !realMenu.hidden && realMenu.children.length === 2);
  press("ArrowDown"); press("Enter");
  check(prompt.value.includes('@"세션/서버 (2)"'), "sessions with the same title receive distinct reference labels");
  input(prompt.value + "@작업/시각");
  await until(() => !realMenu.hidden && realMenu.textContent.includes("시각 개선"));
  press("Enter");
  check(prompt.value.includes('@"작업/시각 개선"'), "task completion preserves a title containing spaces");
  input(prompt.value + "@src/a");
  await until(() => !realMenu.hidden && realMenu.textContent.includes("src/app.js"));
  press("Enter");
  press("Enter");
  await until(() => requests.some((item) => item.url === "/api/sessions/s1/messages"));
  const sent = requests.find((item) => item.url === "/api/sessions/s1/messages").body;
  check(sent.prompt === "@agenthub://session/b @agenthub://session/duplicate @agenthub://task/task-ui @src/app.js", "real send expands session, task and file references to stable identifiers");
  check(JSON.stringify(sent.references) === JSON.stringify([
    { label: "세션/서버", path: "agenthub://session/b" },
    { label: "세션/서버 (2)", path: "agenthub://session/duplicate" },
    { label: "작업/시각 개선", path: "agenthub://task/task-ui" },
    { label: "app.js", path: "src/app.js" },
  ]), "message payload preserves all selected labels and original destinations");
  return checks;
})()
